scope: One exact published Canada Rocket Company dossier target selected for comprehensive source-verified enrichment and private Admin Review.

prospects.name: Canada Rocket Company
prospects.fitSummary: Canada Rocket Company lets a reviewer assess whether the R-1, R-2 and E-1 path, Etobicoke engine facility and preliminary turbopump work justify an updated first conversation; Corporations Canada, BDC and IEEE Spectrum provide the principal independent evidence routes.

recoveryAttempts.outcome: Confirmed the current R-1, R-2 and E-1 architecture, public contact and the internal R-2 payload conflict on the official product surface.
Confirmed the active federal legal entity, 2025 incorporation, registered office, directors and disclosed direct-control bands.
Confirmed agreement CO5-023, its C$8,333,333 value, dates, legal recipient and light-lift development purpose.
Confirmed NRC IRAP agreement 1041206 and its C$75,000 defence procurement and cybersecurity-readiness scope without inferring qualification.
Confirmed BDC's 2025 Seed Venture Fund relationship and the separate C$6.2 million co-led round announcement.
Confirmed the August R-2 emphasis, 12,000-to-15,000-kilogram projection, late-2027 engine static-fire expectation and years-to-orbit boundary.
Confirmed preliminary turbopump work, the Etobicoke facility, undisclosed test site, launch-site discussions and absence of a completed hot-fire or flight.
Searched CanadaBuys, Transport Canada launch-licensing and public customer records; no CRC procurement award, launch licence, booking or manifested payload was located.
Searched CIPO and public patent records under the company, legal entity and principals; no attributable CRC patent or technical filing was located.
Confirmed the French DND Launch the North surface and French-interface NRC record; they added terminology but no different decision-changing facts.
